Abelian Varieties
J. S. Milne
January 2, 2022
Abstract
This the original TEX file for my article Abelian Varieties, published as Chapter
V of Arithmetic geometry (Storrs, Conn., 1984), 103–150, Springer, New York, 1986.
The table of contents has been restored, some corrections have been made,1 there are
minor improvements to the exposition, and an index has been added. The numbering is
unchanged.
